title: QA run · observations:18.2.0-w2 (9/9) · fb91e979 · 2026-10-27 · 5 CONFIRMED / 0 NOT-REPRODUCED / 4 BY-DESIGN
body:
Re-verification of the nine observations that the 18.2.0 wave-2 runners saw but did not file. Wave anchor: #25807. Source records: #26468, #26450, #26456, #26476, #26481. This is a test run, not a lane card. Each observation was reproduced twice, on two fresh boots, and then judged CONFIRMED, NOT REPRODUCED or BY DESIGN. A BY DESIGN verdict cites the contract text that makes it so.

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: `objectstack-ai/objectstack` `main` at `fb91e97933c14dbc7d3ecf9ade0fecae22be7151` (origin/main at checkout, 2026-10-27T10:52Z). `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build --concurrency=2` and `pnpm console:build` all exit 0. The Console builds from this tree's `ui/`; no `.objectui-sha` pin remains.
- App: `examples/app-showcase`, booted twice per the dogfood-verification skill: `setsid pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:RUN/data.db`, with `OS_PORT` exported. Each boot had its own port and its own file DB: boot A on 47611, boot B on 47612. Seed admin was `admin@objectos.ai`. Both boots were stopped by process group afterwards.
- Runtime: node v22.22.0. Health reported version 18.2.0. Posture: stock `single`.
- Scaffolder (observation 6): the published `create-objectstack@latest` (18.2.0), run from the npx cache in a scratch directory outside the repo.
- Runner: one session, sequential, API surface only (no browser).
- Timing: environment prep was about 17 min (10:53–11:10Z, almost all of it the monorepo build). Testing was about 20 min (11:10–11:30Z, including the scaffolder runs, which overlapped the build).

## Verdicts

| # | Observation | Verdict | Evidence, boot A / boot B |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | An API key can mint further keys, and a child outlives its parent's revocation | **BY DESIGN** | A and B: `POST /api/v1/keys` with `x-api-key` answers 201. After the parent is revoked (`PATCH /data/sys_api_key/ID {revoked:true}`, then 403 `API_KEY_REVOKED` for the parent), the child still reads 200 and mints a grandchild (201). Contract: `packages/runtime/src/domains/keys.ts` header, "A generated key therefore acts exactly AS the caller (via `user_id` resolution)". The org is inherited "from the session's `activeOrganizationId` or from the minting key's own stamp", so a key-minted key is anticipated by the mint path. Keys are user-owned peers with no lineage column (`sys-api-key.object.ts`). ADR-0069 D3: an administrator's forced reset "revokes every API key they own". No contract promises a cascade from one key to another. |
| 2 | Anonymous share-link resolve returns `organization_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `owner_id` unless redacted per link | **BY DESIGN** | A and B: on `showcase_client_brief`, a resolve answers 200. Its record carries those columns; only the object default `redactFields` (`internal_notes`, `deal_value`) is stripped. A link minted with those four names in `redactFields` serves without them. Contract: `packages/spec/src/contracts/share-link-service.ts` point 3, "Each resolved link returns a `redactFields` set (object-default ∪ per-link). The REST gateway strips these". `content/docs/protocol/objectql/security.mdx` (Public Share Links) makes `publicSharing.redactFields` the author's lever. The record is served whole minus the declared set. |
| 3 | `sys_audit_log` keeps the full `sys_secret` row, ciphertext included | **CONFIRMED**, authorization class | Reproduced on A and on B. ⛔ Detail withheld pending maintainer (RUNNER rule 2). The card is extracted with no reproduction. |
| 4 | Security explain for a non-existent `userId` answers 200 `allowed:true` with a baseline principal | **CONFIRMED** | A and B: `POST /api/v1/security/explain {object:'showcase_task', operation:'read'|'create', userId:'no_such_user_qa_123'}` as admin answers 200 `allowed:true`. The principal is `positions:['everyone']` and `permissionSets:['showcase_member_default','member_default']`. `GET /data/sys_user/no_such_user_qa_123` answers 404. A second unknown id gave the same answer. Anonymous explain answers 401. |
| 5 | A share link minted with an empty password string has no password gate | **BY DESIGN** | A and B: `POST /share-links {…, password:''}` answers 201, and an anonymous resolve with no password answers 200. The control (`password:'s3cret-pw'`) answers 401 `NEEDS_PASSWORD`. Contract: the password is optional (`CreateShareLinkInput.password?`). The product's own ShareDialog sends `password: draft.password.trim() \|\| undefined` (`ui/packages/components/src/share/ShareDialog.tsx:260`), so a blank field means no password. The service reads it the same way (`input.password ? hash : null`, `share-link-service.ts`). An empty secret would admit anyone anyway. |
| 6 | The scaffolder exits 0 when its own install fails, and accepts a name that is not a legal npm name | **CONFIRMED** (the name half). The install half is BY DESIGN. | Install half, two runs: `npm_config_registry=http://127.0.0.1:9/ create-objectstack app-one --skip-skills` prints `⚠ Dependency installation failed. Run pnpm install manually.`, then `✓ Environment created!`, and exits 0. This is the ruled behaviour: #23865 / PR #23966 kept a failed install non-fatal and made "Next steps" name the install, and the comment in `packages/create-objectstack/src/index.ts` treats a failed install like a skipped one. Name half, two runs: `create-objectstack "My App!" --skip-install` exits 0 and writes `package.json` `"name": "My App!"`. A third run, with a real install: `npm run validate` and `npm run build` pass, and `npm publish --dry-run` fails with `npm error Invalid name: "My App!"`. |
| 7 | `GET /api/v1/meta/webhook/showcase_task_changed` answers `isActive:false` while the activation ledger has it on and it delivers | **BY DESIGN** | A and B: `POST /security/_activation/webhook/showcase_task_changed {enabled:true}` answers 200. The ledger row is `active:true`, and meta still answers `isActive:false`. A `showcase_task` create enqueues a `sys_http_delivery` (`ref_id declared:showcase_task_changed`). Contract: ADR-0126 §4, "`sys_metadata` remains the sole definition ledger … the activation ledger holds a boolean per artifact and nothing else". The `WebhookSchema` header (`packages/spec/src/automation/webhook.zod.ts`) says the ledger "overrides `isActive` in either direction". `catalog-activation.ts`: "⛔ No definition is touched". `/meta` serves the definition. |
| 8 | Data query: `$count=maybe` answers 200, and an empty `$select=` returns full rows | **CONFIRMED** | A and B, `GET /data/showcase_task?$top=2…`: `$count=maybe` answers 200 with `total=11`, read as count-on. `$select=`, `$select=,` and `select=` each answer 200 with all 25 columns. In the same run, `$select=nope` answers 400 and `$top=` answers 400 (the #25229 blank-window refusal). |
| 9 | A field-group `visibleWhen` naming an unknown field saves 200, while the same predicate on an action `visible` is refused 422 | **CONFIRMED** | A and B: `PUT /meta/object/qa_fg_probe` with `fieldGroups:[{key:'g1', visibleWhen:"record.no_such_field == 'x'"}]` answers 200 `state=active`, and the predicate reads back verbatim. The same predicate on `actions[0].visible` answers 422 `expression-invalid`, and on `fields.stage.visibleWhen` it also answers 422 `expression-invalid`. |

Counts: 5 CONFIRMED, 0 NOT-REPRODUCED, 4 BY-DESIGN.

## Reproduction rules (confirmed, non-authorization)

**4. Explain for an unknown user.** On a fresh showcase boot, sign in as the seed admin and send `POST /api/v1/security/explain` with body `{"object":"showcase_task","operation":"read","userId":"no_such_user_qa_123"}`.
- Expected: a refusal that names the unknown user (the `sys_user` id resolves to nothing; `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user/no_such_user_qa_123` answers 404).
- Actual: 200 `allowed:true`. The principal is built from the baseline (`everyone`, `member_default`, the app's member default set).
- Mechanism: `explainAccessForCaller` calls `buildContextForUser(ql, request.userId, …)` with no existence check, and the resolver synthesizes the baseline for any id. `explain-engine.ts` already states the rule for the delegator path: the `sys_user` existence check "is the only correct fail-closed point".

**6. Illegal npm name.** In an empty scratch directory, run `npx -y create-objectstack@latest "My App!" --skip-install; echo $?`.
- Expected: the name is refused, or normalised with a notice.
- Actual: exit 0 and `package.json` `"name": "My App!"`. After an install, `npm publish --dry-run` answers `npm error Invalid name: "My App!"`. `npm run validate` and `npm run build` pass, so nothing on the first-run path reports it.

**8. Malformed list-query values read as the absent default.** On a fresh showcase boot, as admin:
- `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task?$top=2&$select=` (also `$select=,` and `select=`). Expected: 400, as `?$top=` is. Actual: 200, every column.
- `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task?$top=2&$count=maybe`. Expected: 400 (not `true`/`false`). Actual: 200 with `total`.
- Mechanism: the list normalizer in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` splits `fields` with `.filter(Boolean)`, which yields `[]`, and `[]` is served as "no projection". Its boolean step converts only the strings `'true'` and `'false'`, so any other string leaves the count on.

**9. Field-group predicate not validated at the object door.** `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_fg_probe` with body `{"name":"qa_fg_probe","label":"QA","sharingModel":"private","fields":{"name":{"type":"text","label":"Name"},"stage":{"type":"text","label":"Stage","group":"g1"}},"fieldGroups":[{"key":"g1","label":"G1","visibleWhen":"record.no_such_field == 'x'"}]}`.
- Expected: 422 `expression-invalid`, as the same predicate gets on `actions[].visible` and `fields.*.visibleWhen`.
- Actual: 200 `state=active`. The renderer gates the section fail-closed (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`, `isFailClosedSectionGate`), so the group never shows.

## Probe line

About 3 minutes beside observation 3, at the same door and in the same class. The result is withheld with it. No other off-clause probe was run.
